items.title: At-worst-nodal curves are exactly local complete intersections whose Fitting-ideal subscheme is unramified over the base field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma equates the geometric node condition with an lci-plus-unramified-Fitting condition (statement lines 4699-4710). The proof (lines 4712-4760) is a two-direction reference chain in which each implication still has a real hinge: the depth computation making the Fitting points nodes, the dense-smooth-open argument, the unramifiedness of Z, and the transfer of the completed complete-intersection property to the scheme-level notion. The author prefaces it with an editorial remark urging the reader to find their own proof; the steps themselves are all present. H2: systematic assembly of earlier results with the hinges correctly ordered.
